title: Caption Queue
user: Photographers with large shoots who need a fast, deliberate queue for titles, captions, keywords, and IPTC fields without hand-editing every image in a DAM.
smallest_useful_product: A local folder/CSV-driven queue that groups images by shoot, offers reusable caption tokens and controlled vocabularies, previews changes, and writes XMP sidecars.
constraints: Write sidecars by default rather than modify originals; validate IPTC/XMP escaping; no cloud image upload or LLM-generated claims.
